Confirms a previously submitted payout.

To cancel a payout, use the `/declineThirdParty` endpoint.
data.summary_suggestion: Approve a submitted payout for processing
data.description_suggestion: Approves a previously submitted payout, authorizing it for processing and fund transfer. Requires the payout reference from a prior submission. Returns confirmation status and updated payout details. Once confirmed, the payout transitions to processing state and cannot be cancelled. To reject a payout instead, use the `/declineThirdParty` endpoint.

With this call, you can pay out to your customers, and funds will be made available within 30 minutes on the cardholder's bank account (this is dependent on whether the issuer supports this functionality). Instant card payouts are only supported for Visa and Mastercard cards.
data.description_suggestion: Initiates an instant payout to a cardholder's bank account via their card. Supports Visa and Mastercard only. Requires card details, amount, and cardholder information in the request. Funds are typically available within 30 minutes, subject to issuer support. Returns a payout reference and status. The payout is immediately processed and cannot be cancelled after submission.
